cases.input: Counterparty C participates in Projects A and B with different interests and expectations.
cases.expect: One party identity resolves to two context-specific stakeholder relations with separate assertions.

cases.input: Project A reassesses influence after new evidence while Project B is unchanged.
cases.expect: A successor assessment cites and preserves the immutable prior record, states its own dated method, uncertainty, evidence and assessor, and does not affect B.

cases.input: An assessment cites Project A stakeholder relation R-A as its subject.
cases.expect: The relation is independently addressable while party identity remains external and unchanged.

cases.input: C declares two apparently contradictory interests within one perimeter.
cases.expect: Both attributed claims remain visible pending authorized interpretation.

cases.input: A representative mandate is challenged by an affected party.
cases.expect: The mandate remains scoped and contestable and dissent stays attributable.

cases.input: A restricted expectation contributes to an authorized aggregate rating.
cases.expect: The projection preserves restrictions and does not disclose or enable reconstruction of the expectation or evidence.

cases.input: A successor assessment reuses method M1 and evidence E1 after a new dated evaluation.
cases.expect: Reuse is recorded as explicit re-derivation with the successor's own assessor, uncertainty and result; no field is inherited implicitly.

cases.input: A governed projection hides a restricted expectation and its evidence.
cases.expect: A non-reconstructive presence marker remains and distinguishes withheld from missing, not-yet-heard, indeterminate and low.

cases.input: Low influence is written as a permanent attribute of counterparty C.
cases.expect: The write is rejected because influence is a dated contextual assessment.

cases.input: Project A's influence rating is copied into Project B without assessment.
Stakeholder registration is treated as consent for outreach and disclosure.
cases.expect: Both actions are rejected without separate authority.

cases.input: A stakeholder assessment names counterparty C rather than the perimeter-bound stakeholder relation as its subject.
cases.expect: The assessment is rejected because contextual ratings cannot attach to the party master.

cases.input: Project A's restricted expectation text and representation mandate are copied into Project B.
cases.expect: The copy is rejected; restrictions and perimeter scope survive all projections and reuse.

cases.input: Ratings from R-A and R-B are joined into a single party-level influence profile without inference review.
cases.expect: The join is rejected; no contextual rating becomes a party attribute.

cases.input: An analyst's imputed interest is written into WM-ORG-013 as if declared by the stakeholder.
cases.expect: The write is rejected; the hypothesis must be an attributed WM-KNW-007 claim.

cases.input: An engagement action proceeds with no pinned permission or decision authority reference.
cases.expect: Execution fails closed and records authority as explicit unknown.
